profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer with over 25 years experience
profile.summary:
Senior software professional with a background in software development, architecture and design, in an Agile environment. Works successfully with stakeholders and management, applying technology to connect people and organizations to achieve their goals.

* Able to dig into technical detail with software development teams, while keeping customer focus
* Able to speak with business customers to convey technical information at an appropriate level
* Mentoring and leadership of development and project teams
* Agile software development: Certified Scrum Master and Scrum Product Owner
* SQL (MySQL, Oracle), and MongoDB
* Java, Python, C++, Linux CLI
* Requirements gathering, use case / user stories
* Software architecture

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Azure Data Lake Store / Cosmos

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description: Product Manager for Tableau's Data Engine, and now Hyper - enabling Tableau customers to stay in the analytic flow while analyzing their data.  Development of requirements for new features and enhancements, diagnosis of issues, performance testing guidance, and training for Tableau support teams.  Troubleshooting server and data engine issues.  Spoke at Tableau Conference in 2014 and 2015 on how to get the best performance from the data engine.

positions.title: IOS Design and Development
positions.description: Production, development and marketing of iPhone and iPad applications, with three apps in the Apple AppStore.

positions.title: Architect / Business Analyst
positions.description: Requirements analysis and software architecture (short-term contract).

positions.title: Program Manager, ACS Global Quality Management
positions.description:
Drove Business Tools & Process alignment for ACS globally.

Key Achievements
●	Determined options for merging legacy SunPS tools and processes into Oracle and won buy-in from executive stakeholders for retaining a key knowledge management system.
●	Developed use cases and business process requirements for migrating Sun's project repository to Oracle infrastructure, then supported the implementation team through development and testing.
●	Assisted the field to migrate processes and templates to ease the transition, and created custom reports to bridge the gaps.
●	Worked with Oracle Global Risk Management to align Sun project classification criteria with formal review requirements to safeguard project margin.
●	Developed tools and training for evaluating risk and estimating contingency.
●	Migrated process documentation from Confluence to Oracle Webcenter.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Program Manager / internal consultant driving adoption of customer-facing delivery methodology across consulting groups in the APAC region (Australasia, Asia South, China, Japan and Korea).  Change management, training development and delivery, coaching, methodology development.  

Led the Global Sales & Services team responsible for field readiness for Oracle Projects in Sun's internal deployment of Oracle Projects. Oracle Projects was part of a complete implementation of the Oracle e-Business Suite at Sun, replacing disparate systems throughout the company.  

●	Enabled clear communication of requirements and the solution by building strong relationships with Field Finance, GSC (Invoicing team), Services Delivery, HR, FAM (Financial Applications Management), and the deployment cell team.

●	Identified business impacts, together with field-based project user teams, and worked with the field and deployment teams to develop workarounds and new processes as required.

●	Guided the Oracle Projects deployment through the Sun IT privacy office and data governance processes.

positions.title: Six Sigma Black Belt / APAC Software Services Operations Manager
positions.description:
Ran a Sun Sigma (Six Sigma) project to measure and improve the return on investment for “free” services delivered to customers.

Tracked utilisation and training of consultants

positions.title: Software Practice Lead
positions.description: Responsible for a team of 12 consultants (Java and iPlanet) based in NSW, Queensland and the ACT.  Assigned consultants to billable projects based on their skills and career needs, conducted project reviews, produced management reports and corrective plans. Contributed to training and career development plans for the consultants.  Represented the Software Solutions team in pre-sales with a number of Sun customers and potential customers, working with the Sun's sales force based in Sydney, Brisbane and Canberra.

positions.title: Senior Java Architect
positions.description: Java architect for large corporate eBusiness customers, architecting and developing web sites for telecommunications, transportation and insurance customers.  Java, BEA Weblogic, Sun's Java application servers, internet architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Team Leader
positions.description: Intelligent Network group, architected and developed pre-paid phone card solution - C++, SunOS, Solaris.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed résumé processing software.
